seo.title: Our Story — Étoile
seo.description: A relentless pursuit of culinary perfection.

hero.title: Behind the Étoile
hero.subtitle: A relentless pursuit of culinary perfection.

history.title: Our Genesis
history.description: Étoile Premium was born out of a desire to create an unparalleled dining experience. Every element, from the locally sourced ingredients to the meticulously designed plating, is a testament to our dedication to the culinary arts. We do not just serve food; we craft memories.

milestones.title: The Inception
milestones.description: Chef Julian Dupont envisioned a space where avant-garde techniques meet local terroir.

milestones.title: Farm Partnerships
milestones.description: Establishing relationships with over 100 local organic farms to ensure the highest quality ingredients.

milestones.title: Grand Opening
milestones.description: Étoile opens its doors in Bandung, introducing a new era of fine dining.

philosophy.title: Our Philosophy
philosophy.statement: We source relentlessly, cook precisely, and plate with an architectural mindset.

features.title: Sustainability
features.description: A zero-waste approach in our kitchens and deep respect for the environment.

features.title: Innovation
features.description: Constantly pushing the boundaries of taste, texture, and presentation.

features.title: Heritage
features.description: Honoring traditional culinary foundations while breaking new ground.

team.title: The Maestros
team.description: Meet the visionaries behind our culinary symphony.

members.name: Julian Dupont
members.bio: With over 15 years in Michelin-starred kitchens across Europe, Julian brings a relentless passion for perfection.

members.name: Isabella Chen
members.bio: Curator of our 850+ wine labels, Isabella crafts the perfect pairings for every dish.

members.name: Marcus Thorne
members.bio: Marcus oversees the daily orchestrations of the kitchen, ensuring flawless execution of every plate.
